newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm ends down on conflicting export data.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm ends down on conflicting export data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Lower after conflicting export data by SGS and Caleb Brett. SGS' May 1-25 export estimates of 574,382 tonnes too wide from Caleb Brett's estimate of 450,809 tonnes, said trade. Closure of US soyoil market on Monday leaves little near-direction for local prices. Support seen at 1,200 for Aug.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL- Followed futures, with interest confined to nearby CPOs contract.
"It's too wide a differential...the market is not buying this figure, so there was technical selling," said a trader.

"Most people see the SGS figure as unbelievable, especially those who have been regularly checking on the market," said another trader. "It set off stale-bull liquidation as the market has been locked in a range for some time."
With the closure of the US soyoil market for a holiday on Monday, near-term direction of domestic prices was even harder to predict, said traders.
"If you ask me, I'll still put support at 1,200 (ringgit) for August futures contract," said one trader.
At the close, the August futures contract closed 10 ringgit down at 1,210 ringgit ($483.81) a tonne. Volume was at 2,135 lots.
Physicals followed futures, with interest retained among nearby months, said traders.

May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,275 ringgit against bids of 1,272.50 after trading at 1,282.50 and 1,275. May (central) was offered at 1,270 against bids of 1,265, with earlier trades of 1,275 and 1,267.50.
June (south) saw offers at 1,275 against bids at 1,270 after trading at 1,282.50 and 1,275.
In refined products, June RBD palm oil was offered at $537.50, July at $532.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $530.
June RBD palm olein saw offers at $577.50, July at 567.50, and July/Aug/Sept at $562.50. June was traded at $580, July at $565 and July/Aug/Sept at $560.
June RBD palm stearin was offered at $407.50 and May/June palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $275.
